sounds.name: boot-arp
sounds.what: rising triangle arpeggio C5 E5 G5 C6, a cheerful ready

sounds.name: boot-bells
sounds.what: soft FM bells, the same arpeggio as a chord that blooms

sounds.name: boot-sweep
sounds.what: a sine that rises 300 to 900 Hz with a slight shimmer, then settles

sounds.name: boot-thunk-hum
sounds.what: a relay thunk, then a hum that swells in at 330 Hz with its harmonics

sounds.name: boot-flutter
sounds.what: a flurry of random notes that settles on a chord: the machine thinking, then ready

sounds.name: boot-pluck
sounds.what: three plucked notes, wooden and warm

sounds.name: blip-hi
sounds.what: short sine at 1320 Hz

sounds.name: blip-mid
sounds.what: short sine at 880 Hz

sounds.name: blip-lo
sounds.what: short sine at 587 Hz

sounds.name: blip-tri
sounds.what: short triangle at 740 Hz, a little reedier

sounds.name: blip-droplet
sounds.what: a droplet: pitch falls 1400 to 600 Hz in 60 ms

sounds.name: blip-up
sounds.what: two notes up, 660 then 990 Hz: yes

sounds.name: blip-down
sounds.what: two notes down, 990 then 660 Hz: done

sounds.name: blip-bell
sounds.what: a small FM bell at E5

sounds.name: blip-pluck
sounds.what: a plucked C5, wooden

sounds.name: blip-wood
sounds.what: a woodblock knock, resonant noise at 1 kHz

sounds.name: blip-pop
sounds.what: a soft pop: a sine that jumps up 400 to 900 Hz in 30 ms

sounds.name: tick-soft
sounds.what: a soft click, noise at 1.6 kHz for 8 ms

sounds.name: tick-key
sounds.what: a keyboard key: press and release

sounds.name: type-soft
sounds.what: two seconds of unhurried typing

sounds.name: type-teleprinter
sounds.what: a teleprinter line at ten characters a second, then its bell

sounds.name: chatter-bleeps
sounds.what: three seconds of quiet random pentatonic bleeps, ten a second

sounds.name: chatter-droplets
sounds.what: three seconds of scattered droplets

sounds.name: chatter-relays
sounds.what: three seconds of relay clicks in bursts

sounds.name: compute-sequence
sounds.what: a small sequencer, eight notes a second, a 1970s computer at work

sounds.name: hum-bed
sounds.what: a soft hum at 330 and 495 Hz with a slow drift, to go under a scene

sounds.name: chime-page
sounds.what: three rising notes: a new page

sounds.name: chime-ding
sounds.what: one FM ding at C6: an entry found

sounds.name: chime-question
sounds.what: a glide up, like a raised eyebrow

sounds.name: chime-hmm
sounds.what: two notes, down then up: well, well

sounds.name: error-buzz
sounds.what: two soft buzzes at 330 Hz: not recommended

sounds.name: error-boing
sounds.what: a cartoon boing, falling 700 to 280 Hz with a wobble

sounds.name: whoosh-up
sounds.what: noise that sweeps up, 500 Hz to 4 kHz

sounds.name: whoosh-down
sounds.what: noise that sweeps down, 4 kHz to 500 Hz

sounds.name: zip
sounds.what: a fast sine zip, 400 Hz to 2 kHz in 70 ms

sounds.name: slide
sounds.what: a slow glide 600 to 900 Hz, for something sliding in

sounds.name: off-drop
sounds.what: a falling sine, 900 to 250 Hz, then a click

sounds.name: off-arp
sounds.what: the boot arpeggio falling back down
